welcomeChat.chooseAbove: Pick an option or ask me anything…
welcomeChat.greeting: Namaste! I'm Munshi AI, your digital munshi at SethSathi. Do you already have an account, or shall we create a new one together?
welcomeChat.choiceLogin: I have an account — log in
welcomeChat.goingToLogin: Sure! Taking you to the login page…
welcomeChat.askLanguage: Wonderful, let's set up your account together. First, which language would you like me to use?
welcomeChat.languageSet: Done! I'll talk to you in English from now on.
welcomeChat.askBusiness: Nice to meet you, {{name}}! What's the name of your business?
welcomeChat.askPhone: What's your 10-digit mobile number? You'll sign in with it using a one-time code (OTP).
welcomeChat.askEmail: And your email address? You can also sign in with it.
welcomeChat.askPassword: Last step: create a password of at least 8 characters, for signing in with email.
